sections.q: How big is it and how is it doing?

s.t: Its 2025 accounts show an operating loss of NOK 48 thousand and a net loss of NOK 48 thousand (against a loss of NOK 98 thousand in 2024).
Equity was NOK 6.1 million at the end of 2025 (down NOK 2.0 million on 2024), 64% of total assets of NOK 9.6 million; this equity ratio is computed from the filed figures.
Its 2023 group (consolidated) accounts show revenue of NOK 98.6 million, an operating profit of NOK 4.0 million and a net profit of NOK 1.2 million.
Equity was NOK 27.1 million at the end of 2023, 33% of total assets of NOK 81.8 million; this equity ratio is computed from the filed figures.
The register reports no employee count for it.
This is the first run for this company, so there is no earlier snapshot to compare with; later runs report changes against it.
